skills.skill: Multiply and divide integers, including negatives

misconceptions.pattern: Misapplies the sign rules for multiplication and division (e.g. says a negative times a negative is negative, answering -6 × -7 as -42 instead of 42).

strategies.intent: Multiply or divide the magnitudes, then set the sign: same signs give a positive result, different signs give a negative result. Count the negative factors — an even count is positive, an odd count is negative.
